_howto: HOW TO ADD A BOOK: copy any entry in 'library' and change it. Give it a new short 'id' (like b9).
'shelf' is one of the shelf ids in 'shelves'. 'spine' is the book color (try #8E6A4C, #C9A27C, #6F8A6A).
'url' is the link to the full piece (leave "" if none). For other writers' work add 'author' and 'source' (site name); the app shows 'From <source>, read the original'.
HOW TO ADD A PATH: in 'paths', list book ids in the order to read them. Each book opens after the one before it. That's all.
Meditations and the 'I'm not feeling well' area are never locked.
READ TIME: set 'readMinutes' on each book. 3 or less = Quick read, up to 7 = 5-minute read, more = Sit with it. Books with 'chapters' sit under Books.
LEAVES: finishing a piece earns leaves (see 'leaves'). They only unlock cosmetic gifts in 'corner.gifts' at the listed amount. Nothing is random, nothing costs money, nothing is ever lost.
CORNER: the choices in 'corner' are what members can pick for their reading corner.

before: Eat lightly and drink some water beforehand.
Arrive a few minutes early so you don't rush.
Tell Bryan about any pain, injuries, or areas to avoid.
You can ask for more or less pressure at any time.
after: Drink water through the rest of the day.
Rest if you can. Skip hard workouts today.
A warm shower or bath helps.
Some soreness for a day or two is normal. Gentle stretching helps.
